attributes.action: IT'S COMING HOME - move Bruno Mars' show so we can watch live from Wembley!
attributes.additional_details:
If England's Mens Team beat Spain on Sunday 19th July, then football could be coming home for the first time in 60 years.  We believe fans should be able to cheer on the Three Lions in this historic game from the home of English Football, with a live screening at Wembley Stadium.

However, Bruno Mars is scheduled to perform at Wembley that evening.  While we have the utmost love and respect for Bruno and his fans, we humbly request that the UK Government help co-ordinate an alternative venue.
attributes.background: We call on the UK Government to move Bruno Mars' concert on Sunday 19th July to another suitable venue, and screen the World Cup Final from the home of English Football, Wembley Stadium.

rejection.details: now that the date has passed and the eventuality hasn't arisen this petition is unclear.
